newsitem.title: UK: UK Conservative resigns as Mayhew asssistant.
newsitem.headline: UK Conservative resigns as Mayhew asssistant.

text.p: Conservative member of parliament James Cran has resigned as parliamentary private secretary to Northern Ireland Secretary Sir Patrick Mayhew, Conservative Central Office sources confirmed on Monday.
The sources, quoted by Britain's Press Association news agency, said Cran stood down two months ago from his unpaid post because of boundary changes affecting his constituency.
The sources claimed his resignation, confirmed on the eve of the Conservative Party's crucial last pre-election conference, was not connected with policy differences over Europe or Northern Ireland.
The post of parliamentary private secretary is seen as the first step on the ladder to ministerial responsibility.
